question: Which of the following sectors is the most labour absorbing sector of the economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Agriculture is the most labor-absorbing sector in many developing countries, including India.
 
• A significant portion of the rural population is engaged in agricultural activities, providing employment to a large number of people.
 
• It includes a variety of activities such as crop production, livestock rearing, forestry, and fishing.
 
• The sector is crucial for the livelihood of millions of people, especially in rural areas where other employment opportunities are limited.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agriculture**

 
 
• Agriculture involves the cultivation of plants and rearing of animals for food, fiber, medicinal plants, and other products used to sustain and enhance human life.
 
• It plays a vital role in the economy by providing raw materials to industries, contributing to GDP, and ensuring food security.
 
• Technological advancements and government policies significantly impact agricultural productivity and employment.
 
 
 
• **Industry**
 
 
• The industrial sector includes manufacturing, mining, construction, and utilities.
 
• It contributes to economic development by creating jobs, generating income, and fostering innovation.
 
• However, it is less labor-intensive compared to agriculture, especially with the advent of automation and mechanization.
 
 
 
• **Service**
 
 
• The service sector includes a wide range of activities such as retail, healthcare, education, finance, and information technology.
 
• It is a major contributor to GDP in many economies and has seen significant growth in recent years.
 
• While it provides numerous employment opportunities, it often requires higher skill levels and education compared to agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Banking**
 
 
• The banking sector is a subset of the service industry that deals with the management of financial transactions, savings, and investments.
 
• It plays a crucial role in economic stability and growth by providing credit and financial services to individuals and businesses.
 
• Employment in banking typically requires specialized knowledge and qualifications, making it less labor-intensive compared to agriculture.
